title: How I Learn English
sentences: I have been learning English for about two years.
Men ingliz tilini taxminan ikki yildan beri o'rganyapman.
At first, I only studied grammar from books, and I could not speak at all.
Avvaliga faqat kitoblardan grammatika o'qidim va umuman gapira olmasdim.
Then a teacher told me that speaking is a skill, like swimming.
Keyin bir o'qituvchi menga gapirish suzish kabi ko'nikma ekanini aytdi.
You cannot improve it without practice.
Uni mashqsiz yaxshilab bo'lmaydi.
So I made a new habit: every day I say ten sentences out loud.
Shuning uchun yangi odat qildim: har kuni o'nta gapni ovoz chiqarib aytaman.
I still make mistakes, but I am not afraid of them anymore.
Hali ham xato qilaman, lekin endi ulardan qo'rqmayman.
Mistakes show me what I need to work on.
Xatolar menga nima ustida ishlashim kerakligini ko'rsatadi.
Now I feel much more confident when I talk to tourists.
Endi sayyohlar bilan gaplashganda o'zimni ancha ishonchli his qilaman.
My progress is slow, but it is real.
Rivojlanishim sekin, lekin haqiqiy.

title: Online Shopping
sentences: These days, more and more people buy things online.
Hozirgi kunda tobora ko'proq odamlar narsalarni internet orqali sotib olishmoqda.
It is convenient because you can order anything without leaving your home.
Bu qulay, chunki uydan chiqmasdan istalgan narsani buyurtma qilish mumkin.
You can also compare prices in different shops in a few minutes.
Bir necha daqiqada turli do'konlardagi narxlarni solishtirish ham mumkin.
However, online shopping has some problems too.
Biroq onlayn xaridning ham ba'zi muammolari bor.
Last month, I ordered a jacket, and it was delivered a week late.
O'tgan oy kurtka buyurtma qildim, u bir hafta kechikib yetkazildi.
When I opened the box, the quality was much worse than in the photos.
Qutini ochganimda, sifati suratlardagidan ancha yomon edi.
Luckily, I was able to return it and get my money back.
Baxtimga, uni qaytarib, pulimni qaytarib olishga muvaffaq bo'ldim.
Now I always read other customers' reviews before I buy anything.
Endi biror narsa olishdan oldin doim boshqa xaridorlarning sharhlarini o'qiyman.

title: Small Healthy Habits
sentences: Many people think that a healthy life needs big changes.
Ko'p odamlar sog'lom hayot katta o'zgarishlarni talab qiladi deb o'ylashadi.
In my opinion, small habits are more important.
Menimcha, kichik odatlar muhimroq.
For example, I started drinking a glass of water every morning.
Masalan, men har kuni ertalab bir stakan suv icha boshladim.
I also try to walk for thirty minutes regularly, even when I am busy.
Band bo'lsam ham, muntazam o'ttiz daqiqa piyoda yurishga harakat qilaman.
I avoid using my phone an hour before sleep.
Uxlashdan bir soat oldin telefondan foydalanmayman.
Because of this, I sleep better and have more energy during the day.
Shu tufayli yaxshiroq uxlayman va kun davomida kuchim ko'proq bo'ladi.
My doctor gave me one simple piece of advice: start small and don't stop.
Shifokorim menga bitta oddiy maslahat berdi: kichikdan boshlang va to'xtamang.
I think it is the best advice I have ever received.
O'ylaymanki, bu menga berilgan eng yaxshi maslahat.

title: The Lost Phone
sentences: Last week, something terrible happened to me.
O'tgan hafta boshimga dahshatli voqea tushdi.
I was getting off the bus when I noticed that my phone was gone.
Avtobusdan tushayotganimda telefonim yo'qligini payqadim.
At first, I started to panic, because all my photos and contacts were on it.
Avvaliga vahimaga tushdim, chunki barcha suratlarim va kontaktlarim unda edi.
I borrowed a phone from a stranger and called my own number.
Notanish odamdan telefon olib, o'z raqamimga qo'ng'iroq qildim.
A young woman answered and said she had found it on the seat.
Bir yosh ayol javob berib, uni o'rindiqdan topib olganini aytdi.
We met in front of the station an hour later.
Bir soatdan keyin bekat oldida uchrashdik.
I was so relieved that I wanted to give her a reward, but she refused.
Shunchalik yengil tortdimki, unga mukofot bermoqchi bo'ldim, lekin u rad etdi.
She said, "Anyone would do the same."
U dedi: "Har kim shunday qilardi."
I was grateful to meet such an honest person.
Shunday halol inson bilan uchrashganimdan minnatdor edim.
